card.line: Sepharvaim was a city on the Euphrates whose people were settled in Samaria by Assyria, and whose fallen gods and king Assyria used to mock the LORD.

moments.title: Settlers sent to Samaria
moments.text: The king of Assyria brought people from Sepharvaim and other places to live in the towns of Samaria, replacing the Israelites who had been exiled.

moments.title: Gods of Sepharvaim
moments.text: The Sepharvites in Samaria burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim. They kept their old customs even as they also worshiped the LORD.

moments.title: The Rabshakeh's taunt
moments.text: The Assyrian official asked where the gods of Sepharvaim and other lands were. He said they had not saved their lands, so the LORD could not save Jerusalem.

moments.title: Hezekiah prays over the letter
moments.text: A letter from Sennacherib asked where the king of Sepharvaim was. Hezekiah spread it out before the LORD and prayed for rescue, so all kingdoms would know the LORD alone is God.
